preregistered_analysis.H1_dose_matched_restoration_L11: cell SUPPORTIVE iff dM_main > max(dM_doserand_s1, dM_doserand_s2); content-specific at L11 iff >= 10/16 cells supportive (chance per cell ~1/3 if direction is irrelevant) AND every donor group has a supportive cell AND median(dM_main - max doserand) > 0
preregistered_analysis.H1b_dose_matched_suppression_L11: cell SUPPORTIVE iff dM_main < dM_doserand_s1; reported with the main vs donor-side SA-sham difference (Stage-B equivalence)
preregistered_analysis.H2_layer_localization: for L in 11..14: median dM_main per direction; boundary = first layer whose |median dM_main| < 10% of its L11 value in both directions
preregistered_analysis.H3_encoding: per scene and layer: delta_s(L) = mean over span positions of h_new - h_SA (C row). Conflict direction u(L) = normalised mean delta over donors, leave-one-donor-out for donor scores; score p_s(L) = delta_s(L) . u(L). Prediction (encoding failure): at L11 the median p of FFF scenes (missed) < every held-out donor's p, and AUC(FTF vs FFF) >= 0.9. Profile over all 24 layers is descriptive.
preregistered_analysis.readout: M = logit(true) - logit(false) on the C row; dM vs the Stage-A raw baseline of the patched arm (bitwise-replayed in phase 1)
preregistered_analysis.replication: 64 L11 rows bitwise == Stage-B rows; 248 capture forwards bitwise == Stage-A rows
preregistered_analysis.units: source groups (3 donor, 4 host); cells not independent; thresholds are descriptive decision rules, not p-values
